title: Antique Pewter 28-Inch Freestanding Toilet Paper Stand - European Style Solid Brass Toilet Tissue Holder (Traditional), Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Antique Pewter, keep toilet paper within easy reach without drilling into tile or sacrificing wall space, which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, this freestanding European style toilet tissue stand adds a refined, traditional touch to your bathroom.

  • Antique Pewter blends effortlessly with transitional decor
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Enjoy added stability from a heavy base that helps prevent tipping
  • Choose a look that fits your space with a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes
  • Count on solid brass construction that outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces to create a coordinated set of classic bath accessories.

Specs
Product type: Freestanding toilet paper stand / toilet tissue stand
Material: Brass
